parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1-500 (default 100). An empty, repeated, non-integer or out-of-range value is 400 `invalid-limit`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque page token: the `nextCursor` of the previous page, with the same filters repeated. A token that does not decode is 400 `invalid-cursor`. Any query parameter the collection does not declare is 400 `unknown-query-parameter`.

parameters.name: siteCode
parameters.description: The site's code — the first segment of every LocationCode inside it.

schema.description: What a location on the map is FOR (ADR-0016). Storage is the default and only role that existed before this ADR; the rest cover non-storage functional locations that previously had no place on the map at all.
schema.title: LocationRole
